message: Kotlin writes $price here, a number from the server, which is safe in a Datastar expression. Meant as the signal $price, make the literal $$"""...""" (Kotlin 2.2+), or escape as ${'$'}price.

Kotlin writes ${title.escaped()} into the HTML as it is. If it can hold text from outside, build the string with interpolate(...), which escapes it; if it is markup you built, declare it Html or wrap it in Trusted(...). interpolate(...) is not offered here: it would escape this value, which may be markup you built.
